name: Slovenia
summary: Possessing any drug for personal use is a misdemeanour (fine), not a crime; a lower fine or none is possible for a one-off small amount or if you enter treatment. Supply is a crime. Free, legal drug checking (DrogArt).

emergency.poisonControlNote: No separate public poison hotline could be verified; call 112.

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law, but possession for own use is only a misdemeanour and medical staff are bound by confidentiality. Police may attend if there is a death or violence.
drugChecking: Legal and free: DrogArt runs anonymous drug checking in Ljubljana and Maribor (lab analysis by NLZOH) and reagent testing.

zpppd.title: Production of and Trade in Illicit Drugs Act (ZPPPD), art. 33 (possession for own use = misdemeanour)

wikiCannabis.title: Wikipedia: Cannabis in Slovenia (decriminalised; fines; medical cannabis act 2025)

ansa2025.title: ANSA (24 Jul 2025): parliament overrides veto on the Medical and Scientific Use of Cannabis Act

wikiMush.title: Wikipedia: Legal status of psilocybin mushrooms (Slovenia: decriminalised)

drogart.title: DrogArt: anonymous drug checking, testing points and lab reports

un1971.title: INCB Green List: psychotropic substances under international control (1971 Convention)

euN2O.title: EU Perspectives (Mar 2026): nitrous oxide classified reprotoxic; large canisters may be barred from consumer sale from Feb 2027

lsd.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine (roughly €40–210), lower for a one-off small amount. Selling or sharing is a crime.

mushrooms.note: Possessing psilocybin mushrooms for own use is a misdemeanour fine; supplying them is a crime. Growing is not specifically penalised unless for drug use.

dmt.note: Controlled (UN Schedule I). Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. Ayahuasca contains DMT.

mescaline.note: Controlled (UN Schedule I). Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime.

dox.note: DOB, DOM, DOC are UN-scheduled. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime.

nbomes.note: 25I/25B/25C-NBOMe are UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime.

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are UN-scheduled. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not UN-scheduled; whether 5-MeO-DMT and related tryptamines are on Slovenia's national list was not verified.

cannabis.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine. A Medical and Scientific Use of Cannabis Act was adopted in July 2025; recreational use remains prohibited.

ketamine.note: Prescription/veterinary anaesthetic. Without a prescription, possession is treated like other drugs (misdemeanour fine).

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is UN Schedule II. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

dxm.note: Not internationally controlled; pharmacy (OTC vs prescription) status in Slovenia was not verified.

nitrous.note: Not a known controlled drug; national sales rules were not verified. EU limits on large canisters may apply from 2027.

amphetamines.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. ADHD medicines (e.g. methylphenidate) are prescription-only.

mdma.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine (roughly €40–210); supply is a crime. DrogArt can test pills.

cocaine.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; selling or sharing is a crime.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale and serving to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is controlled; possession for own use is a misdemeanour fine. Status of GBL/1,4-BD not verified. Oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. Prescription opioids need a prescription; opioid substitution is available.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine; whether possession without a prescription is penalised was not verified.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only, UN Schedule IV; possession without a prescription is treated as an illicit-drug misdemeanour.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs are prescription-only. The status of harmala/Syrian rue was not verified; DMT in ayahuasca is controlled.
